operation_details.item: The user always chooses open hot-desking in noisy common areas for on-site client work instead of private meeting rooms or focus spaces.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: For the upcoming client engagement, how would you like to approach the two-week on-site phase at headquarters?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I want the setup to support frequent observation and informal conversations rather than keeping me isolated in scheduled meetings.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That suggests being close to the teams doing the work, with enough flexibility to move between discussions, observation, and analysis as the day develops.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Exactly. I do not want an elaborate consultant-style command center or a tightly scripted daily routine.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Would you prefer a private room, a designated project room, or a more open area for your base during the visit?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: For on-site client work, I always choose open hot-desking in noisy common areas instead of private meeting rooms or focus spaces.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: For a two-week phase, I would suggest arranging an open hot-desk in a busy common area, keeping your materials lightweight, and using short blocks for synthesis between conversations.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: That works. I would also rather capture patterns as they emerge than wait for formal interview rounds to finish.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Then the working setup could include a simple observation log, brief end-of-day synthesis, and an easily accessible place for emerging questions and process examples.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Keep it practical and low overhead, with room to adjust based on what I encounter on-site.
